headline: Where Harbourline Electric is quietly losing clients
intro: The site is clear about what you do and where you do it — but here is where enquiries are going missing before they ever reach you.
headlineCost: You already pay to get these leads, through referrals and the time you put into being found. Every one that hits this gap is money you have already spent to earn somebody who now slips away before they reach you.

findings.title: Evenings and weekends have nowhere for an enquiry to land
findings.problem: Your Google listing shows evenings and weekends closed, and the scan found no booking path and no chat window anywhere on the site.
findings.whyItCosts: A tripped main does not wait for office hours, and where nothing catches those hours the enquiry typically goes to whoever answered first.

findings.title: There is no way to book you without a phone call
findings.problem: Neither the site nor your Google profile carries a booking link, so every appointment has to go through a conversation while somebody in the office is free to have one.
findings.whyItCosts: A homeowner who decides at 10pm has to remember to ring in the morning, and remembering is where a lot of that intent quietly dies.

findings.title: Every enquiry arrives looking exactly the same
findings.problem: The contact form collects a name, an email, a phone number and a message box. Nothing on it says what the job is, where it is, or how urgent it has become.
findings.whyItCosts: A panel upgrade gets read in the same order as a single dead outlet, so the biggest job of the week routinely waits the longest.

findings.title: A call that rings out has nothing behind it
findings.problem: The published number is a single line with no text-back path anywhere on the site, so what happens to a call nobody picks up is not something a scan can see from out here.
findings.whyItCosts: Where that pattern holds, a caller who cannot get through typically dials the next company within minutes, and nothing brings them back.

deeperLeakQuestions: what happens to enquiries after hours — When an enquiry lands at 9pm, what happens to it before morning?
missed calls nobody chases — When a call gets missed, who calls that person back — and how long do they wait?
how fast someone actually gets back — From the moment someone reaches out, how long before a real person gets back to them?
quotes that go quiet — When a quote goes out and you hear nothing back, what happens next?
no-shows nobody rebooks — When someone books and doesn't show up, who gets them back on the calendar?
past customers nobody contacts again — When did the customers you looked after last year last hear from you?
How many inquiries came in last month — and how many actually became clients? The gap between those two numbers is usually where the money is.

performance.readout: Measured on a typical phone. Slower, less stable pages quietly cost calls and bookings before people ever see your offer.

closingCta.tiedToFinding: There is no way to book you without a phone call
closingCta.message: That is the half a scan can see. The other half is six questions I can only ask you — that's what the call is for.
